P16.answer: Cannot tell. I could not recognise any Greek letter. The left end of the line is on the separate left fragment (A x~60-525), and at target height its surface is heavily corroded. Visible forms, from left to right: (i) A x~100-130: a faint wedge/diagonal at the fragment edge, unreadable. (ii) A x~265-340: two roughly horizontal strokes (y~128-135 and y~178-185) joined at the right by a curved stroke. The shape is closed on the right and open on the left, so it does not match Σ (open to the right), Χ or Ξ. In Stage 1 I read it as ב/כ. (iii) A x~345-400: an upright (x~350, y~115-185) with strokes fanning from its lower part to the upper right, a feathered star-like form. It could be a Χ-like cross with an extra upright, or a ש-like letter (Stage 1). (iv) A x~440-500: faint horizontal and diagonal traces. Nowhere do I see three parallel horizontal bars (Ξ).
P16.evidence: A left fragment at 1.85-5x zoom (plain, CLAHE, background-subtracted). B left strips (B x~150-470) show only a round dark blob (hole?) at B x~200-240, y~100-130 and diffuse shadows, no strokes. C covers only the right fragment.

P16.answer: Possibly. The free-standing upright at A x~350 (about full letter height) could be an Ι standing next to form (iii), or it may be the stem of form (iii) itself. The strokes fanning across its lower half could be overwriting, but they could equally be corrosion. I cannot say whether it is cancelled.
P16.evidence: A 5x zoom x~250-420, y~100-210; no confirmation in B or C.

P16.answer: Cannot tell. Reading left to right, the last recognisable form is (iv) or (iii). Reading right to left, the letter nearest the gap between the fragments (A x~420-505) is illegible. The left edge (A x~77-255) has no countable letters.
P16.evidence: A left fragment; X-rays do not help.

P16.answer: The left end of the right-hand fragment (A x~838-930) has only Hebrew-type forms: a U-shaped letter with a heavy base (A x~870-925, left short upright at x~877) and a small box cut by the fragment edge (x~840-860). No Greek letters are seen there.

P17.answer: Word division is uncertain, so I give the letters of the candidate words. The only unambiguous word space is at A x~560-620, between my pos 9 and pos 10. Right of it the letters are evenly spaced. The widest gaps there (~20-25 px, against ~10-15 px elsewhere) are at A x~720-740 (between pos 7 ו and pos 8 כ) and A x~930-948 (between pos 3 ו and pos 4 ח). If these are word spaces: word 1 = א ע ו (pos 1-3); word 2 = ח ? ל ו (pos 4-7: ח probable (ה possible); an illegible zigzag letter (ע/צ/ש); ל probable (tall ascender); ו probable); word 3 = כ ו (pos 8-9: כ probable (ב possible; top stroke, right vertical, base without heel); ו probable (closed 9-like head)). Then the clear space and ב א ל ו ... (pos 10 ב probable with heel, pos 11 א probable, pos 12 ל probable, pos 13 ו possible, then illegible letters). If instead only the clear space is a word boundary, the second word is ב א ל ו ? (pos 10-14) and the third word cannot be delimited in the damaged left part.
P17.evidence: A ink profile along the line (gaps: x~560-615 zero ink; x~720-735 and 930-945 low ink; others ~5-10 px). A 1.8-2.4x crops. The B left strip confirms ב + א (pos 10-11); the C left strip shows the ו-כ-ו group (pos 7-9) faintly.

P18.answer: I cannot securely find a word that reads חפור. Two candidates: (1) pos 9-12: a two-legged roofed letter (ח/ה), an ע-like letter (a long diagonal descending below the baseline with a short left arm), a closed inverted-triangle letter, then a ר-type letter (top bar + right vertical). (2) pos 3-6, just before a raised dot: an unclear letter (vertical + rising diagonal + base; not a ח), a closed loop tapering to a point at lower left (could be פ), a ו, and a vertical with a leftward stroke. Neither candidate reads cleanly as ח-פ-ו-ר.
P18.evidence: A crops x~440-1270 at 2.4-2.5x (plain and CLAHE); B left strip (x~350-720) and B right strip (x~950-1360) at 1.75-2.2x.

P18.q: P18 (following word, first letter א or ג)
P18.answer: Neither א nor ג is clearly present. If candidate 1 is the word: next comes pos 13. In B (both strips) pos 13 is a small ר-like letter (short top bar + right vertical, no base); in A the same position shows a head, a vertical and a horizontal base running left (נ/ב-like). It is followed by a closed triangular/box letter (pos 14; ∇-shaped in B, a box with inner stroke in A) and a loop with a long descender (pos 15, ף/ק). None of these has the diagonal-and-legs form of א. A ג would need a foot slanting down-left from the vertical; the base in A is horizontal and long, and B shows no foot. If candidate 2 is the word: the next letter (pos 7) is a box letter with head, top bar, right vertical and base (ב/כ), again neither א nor ג.
P18.evidence: A x~560-640 and x~840-900; B left strip x~520-610 (two ר-like letters in succession between two closed triangles); B right strip x~1060-1160 (same).

P18.q: P18 (additional letter such as ר before it)
P18.answer: Under candidate 1, yes, possibly. In B there are two ר-like letters in succession (pos 12 with a vertical reaching a little below the baseline, and pos 13 smaller). One of them could be an additional ר. A and B disagree on pos 13, since A shows a base. Under candidate 2 there is no extra letter, only a raised dot (A x~920-935, y~155-165) before pos 7.
P18.evidence: B left strip x~520-610 and B right strip x~1060-1160; A x~565-645.

P19.answer: I could not identify a clear ת-ח pair. The closest is my pos 5-7: a letter with a top stroke and a base whose interior is hidden by a heart-shaped blob (pos 5), a long slanting vertical descending below the baseline (pos 6; together with pos 5 it could form a ת-like letter), then a roofed letter with a detached left leg (pos 7, ה/ח). After pos 7, left towards the break: a ~15 px gap (A x~705-720, possibly a word space), then a short hooked stroke in the upper half (י, probable), a vertical with a base running left (נ, probable), a letter with thick rounded head, right vertical and base (ב, possible), a full-height vertical (ו, probable), a long straight crack (A x~540-552; not a letter), a letter with top bar and right vertical reaching slightly below the baseline (A x~495-535) plus a detached short stroke under the left end of the bar (A x~483-490) and a base stroke at the broken edge (A x~455-490, y~185). This last group could be a ר followed by the base of a further letter, or one ת (bar + right leg + detached left leg with foot). Traces that could belong to a new word: yes. If the gap at A x~705-720 is a word space, then י-נ-ב-ו-... is a new word. The base stroke at the break (a box-like letter in C) is the last surviving trace; nothing survives beyond the break.
P19.evidence: A 2.1-3x crops x~380-1000 and an ink profile (zero ink at x~705-720 and 745-755). The C left strip shows a box letter with base and right vertical at C x~380-420 and a U/box form at C x~305-360 just before the bright broken zone (C x~200-290), which agrees with A. B was not used (less clear).

P20.answer: Word boundaries at the left end are not visible, so the letter count is uncertain. The only clear word space is A x~800-900, and if the last word began there it would have ~11 letters, which suggests there are divisions I cannot see. The letters at the end, right to left, are: ט (probable), ט (probable), a vertical with a foot slanting down-left (ג/נ, possible), a V-shaped letter (ע, possible), a tall stroke with a diagonal arm (ל/ש-arm, possible), a tall roofed letter (roof at y~55-65, legs to y~150-160) with an inner short vertical under the roof (A x~300-305, y~100-150), and finally a vertical at A x~250-260 running from y~115 to ~180, about 20 px below the baseline of the ט's, with a short bar at its top extending right. Ending: the final vertical descends below the baseline, so a ן is possible. The inner short vertical in the roofed letter could be a י squeezed in, so an ending י-ן is possible but not established. A ר ending (top bar + right vertical, on the baseline) is not seen. Left of the last vertical is only a long fold/crack (A x~205-215) and damaged surface. Caveat: this left end sits where the line above descends (its letters at A x~250-560 occupy y~40-100). The roof at y~55-65 and the upper parts of the tall letters may belong to the line above, with separate letters of the target line (y~100-160) directly under them; a short horizontal at y~100-105 (x~280-310) supports that split. The letters of the target line proper at this end would then be: [a small letter with a horizontal at y~100 and an inner vertical] + [the final vertical descending below the baseline].
P20.evidence: A 2.3-4x zooms x~180-560 (plain and CLAHE); ink profile along the line. B and C do not clearly cover the left end.

P21.answer: Word spaces are hard to see. The widest gaps are at A x~850-862 (between pos 5 and pos 6), x~990-1002 and x~645-652. I therefore cannot say which letters form the third word. Towards the break, the last letters are: a closed rectangle (pos 10, ם-type, probable), a short gap (~10 px), a full-height vertical (pos 11, ו/י, probable), and at the very edge of the break (A x~538-546) a short dark trace at letter height, possibly the right side of one more letter. The fragment edge runs obliquely from about (555,50) to (480,210). Left of it only the smooth backing is visible, with no traces. Lost letter-spaces: at least one letter is partly lost (the edge trace). How many more is unknown, because the left margin of the column is not preserved in this image. The line below survives only ~40 px (about one letter) further left.
P21.evidence: A overview and 4.5x zoom x~490-670; ink profile (ink at x~540-545, zero at 550, vertical at 560-567). C left strip shows closed rectangles and a vertical at the left end before the strip edge but nothing beyond. B not usable for this end.

P22.answer: Right to left: (ו?) - closed box with gabled/peaked top and an inner horizontal (my Stage-1 pos 13, read there as ס with alternatives ם/ט/מ; fits the מ the question names) - ש (vertical with two diagonals rising to the upper right; pos 14) - a letter with an arched top whose lower part is damaged (pos 15) - a roofed two-legged letter (pos 16) - end of line. The line ends there: a faint vertical just left of the last letter (A x~212) does not show in B, so it is probably not a stroke. Whether pos 12 ו (A x~480-500) belongs to this word cannot be seen (no clear space).
P22.evidence: A x~200-500 at 2.8-6x zoom; B strip 1 (x~150-430) shows the same sequence: gable box (B x~380-430), ש (B x~320-375), arch (B x~265-310), crack (B x~250), two-legged roofed letter (B x~170-245).

P22.answer: Cannot decide between מ and ט. The letter after מ-ש has a rounded arch top (an inverted U, B x~265-310, A x~305-345). Below it B shows a dark horizontal that could be a flat base, which would make a closed rounded letter more like ט (or ס) than מ, but that horizontal joins a crack network, and in A the lower half is covered by a raised blob with a crack through it. No mem-type open left side or tail can be seen.
P22.evidence: A: arch stroke at y~95-125 above a blob (y~135-175) and a vertical crack at x~300-310. B strip 1: clear arch, then a thick horizontal at y~150 that runs into a thinner crack line going right.

P22.answer: No independent ו can be confirmed. In A there is a short vertical at x~288-298 between the arch letter and the final roofed letter, but it lies against the long vertical crack. At the matching place in B (x~250) there is only the crack, with no separate stroke.
P22.evidence: A 6x zoom x~200-320; B strip 1 x~240-260 (crack only).

P22.answer: ח (het). Both legs join the roof. The left leg (A x~238) meets the roof as clearly as the right leg (A x~268). The roof overhangs slightly at both ends and has small upward ticks above the legs (seen in B).
P22.evidence: A x~225-285 (roof y~88-98, legs to y~150); B strip 1 x~170-245 shows the left leg reaching the roof. Alternative ה is less likely because no gap is visible at the top of the left leg in either image.

P22.answer: No supralinear letter and no correction or cancellation mark (dots or strokes) is visible around this word. What is present: letters of the line above at their normal height; a raised blob and a vertical crack under and beside the arch letter; a crack network in B below the ש and arch letter; a faint vertical in A just left of the ח that is not confirmed in B.
P22.evidence: A crops x~150-520, y~0-110 (above the line) and y~30-200; B strip 1.

P23.answer: The first letter at the right edge is ו: a full-height vertical with a blunt head at A x~1015-1040, just left of the vertical seam. It is followed at normal letter spacing (gap ~10-15 px, no visible word space) by a V/wedge-shaped letter, then a letter with a top bar and right vertical (ד/ר). This is compatible with ו + עד written together. It is a single letter standing before a possible עד, but it is not separated from it by a visible space. Nothing is written right of the ו: the seam at A x~1050-1100 and the plain strip beyond carry no strokes at target height, and in C there is ~80 px of blank metal between the ו and the strip edge. A letter lost inside the seam cannot be fully excluded.
P23.evidence: A x~860-1180 zoom plus an ink profile along the line (ink at x~1015-1035, low at x~1000-1010, then the wedge at x~945-1000). C right strip (x~720-870, y~150-220) shows, from the right, a vertical with a split (Y-like) head at x~860, a V-shaped letter at x~790-840 and a top-bar + vertical letter at x~720-750. This agrees with A. The wedge is ע (possible) and the third letter ד (possible, knob at the upper right corner in A) rather than ר.

P24.answer: Cannot tell. I could not find a ככ group at the left end of the target line. The line ends (left) with: a shin/ayin-like letter (Stage-1 pos 9, A x~485-555), a short vertical with a head (pos 10, A x~466-482), faint diagonal traces (pos 11, A x~425-445), then two long dark vertical bands at A x~350-400. These bands run through three lines and look like folds, not unit strokes. In C the original is broken off just left of the corresponding place: one vertical stroke-like line (C x~195-205, y~95-145) stands on the break edge, and to its left there is only the break. Visible vertical strokes that could be units: at most 1-2 (pos 10 and the C edge stroke), and they are not preceded by a recognisable ככ. Damage certainly could hide strokes: the fragment is broken off to the left of A x~390 / C x~190, and A x~100-390 shows only a smooth patch, cracks and fold bands.
P24.evidence: A x~90-760 zooms (plain and CLAHE); C left strip aligned to A by the aleph (C x~545-620 = A x~745-802, offset ~+200 px). B is too blurred and holed (large dark hole at B x~200-300) to count strokes.

P25.answer: Second-to-last word: ש ל (Stage-1 pos 9-10). The ש is a left vertical with two curved strokes rising to the upper right (A x~465-520). The ל has an ascender from above the line, an arm to the right and a hook back down-left (A x~415-460). A low-ink gap at A x~520-550 before the ש may be a word space, so this word may be just של. Last word: a letter at A x~305-380 made of a left vertical with two diagonal arms rising to the upper right (ש, possible; in Stage 1 I split this area into two illegible positions, pos 11-12, and I now think it is one letter), then a vertical fold/crack band at A x~235-290 in which a narrow letter could be hidden, then a box letter with top stroke, right vertical and base (ב, alternatives כ/נ; A x~160-215). Left of that the surface is plain (A x~35-150), so the line ends there.
P25.evidence: A crops x~0-540 (plain, CLAHE, smoothed CLAHE); slanted-band ink profile along the rising line. B left strip only roughly confirms the hooked ל. C does not cover this end clearly.

P25.q: P25 (space between ש-ל and following ש)
P25.answer: A small gap is visible: ~25-35 px of low ink between the foot of the ל (A x~415) and the rightmost arm of the next letter (A x~380). It is larger than the normal letter spacing (~10-15 px) and similar to the gap before the ש of של (A x~520-550). A raised figure-8 blob (casting defect) sits in it at A x~395-410. So a word space is possible but not certain.
P25.evidence: A ink profile: values 6-10 at x~385-410 against 20-45 inside letters; 4.0x zoom x~280-470.

P25.q: P25 (length and last letter of last word)
P25.answer: Two letters are visible (ש? + ב). A third, narrow letter could be hidden in the fold at A x~235-290. Last letter: ב, a box with right vertical and base, no heel visible (alternatives כ, נ).
P25.evidence: A x~150-300 at 4x zoom: top stroke y~86-95 (x~168-190), right vertical x~211-221, base y~136-145. Nothing further left.

P26.answer: Numeral reading uncertain. If the two box letters I read as ב in Stage 1 (pos 9 at A x~585-660 and pos 11 at A x~460-515, separated by a crack and a short diagonal) are ככ, then what follows, right to left, is: (1) one large sign at A x~370-455: a tall, very straight upright (from y~30 above the line down to y~150) plus a box-like part with a top stroke only on the right, a right vertical and a base. This could be a large hook-shaped sign or a ם with a crack along its left side. (2) Two diagonal strokes descending to the right (A x~315-360). (3) One large rounded arch/hook sign with a heavy right leg reaching below the baseline and a weaker left leg (A x~245-305). (4) Vertical strokes: one slanting stroke (A x~225-240) and two faint parallel strokes (A x~188-215), 3 in all. (5) Faint traces to the fragment edge (A x~120-185). Count: 1-2 large hook-shaped signs (the arch is the clearer; the first is doubtful), 1 diagonal-pair sign, about 3 vertical strokes, and possibly more hidden in the corroded end.
P26.evidence: A x~90-470 at 1.5-4x zoom, plain and CLAHE. The surface at the left end is corroded and the straight upright at x~370-395 has the profile of a crack. C lower row shows box shapes and an inverted-V form but could not be aligned stroke by stroke. B could not be aligned.

P27.answer: Four arch-shaped signs (inverted U with two legs) follow the ככ in both clear X-ray strips. The first sign after ככ (rightmost) is somewhat larger and has a more pointed, peaked top. The next three are smaller, rounder and alike. So: three repeated signs of identical shape, plus a fourth of the same general arch type but larger and pointed, which I count as the same sign family (4) with some hesitation (3 + 1 variant). The ככ are two small signs, each a horizontal with a vertical on the right (7-shaped), at C strip 13 x~975-1000 and 1025-1050, and 13B x~1440-1465 and 1495-1515. The sequence looks complete. Left of the last (fourth) arch, strip 13 shows ~30-40 px of plain surface up to a vertical crack (x~785-800), and beyond it no arch. A crack runs through the third arch in both strips 13 and 13B but does not remove a whole sign (the arch spacing is regular: ~30-35 px). The broken lower edge of the strip lies below the signs (y~140) and cuts only the bottoms of the legs. I could not locate this group in the electrotype A (A's line at this height shows letters, with a blistered zone at A x~500-680), so the alignment of C with A is uncertain.
P27.evidence: C strip 13: arches at x~815-845, 850-880, 885-915 (cracked), 925-955 (larger, pointed). C strip 13B: arches at x~1290-1320, 1320-1350, 1355-1385 (cracked), 1390-1420 (larger, pointed). C strip 13C (x~330-460) is blurred but shows arch forms. B does not cover this group; A not aligned.

P28.answer: The word beginning הצ is probably my Stage-1 pos 16-18: a two-legged roofed letter (ח/ה), then a U-shaped letter with an arm rising outward to the upper right (read ט in Stage 1, alternative צ), then a rounded letter with an inner hook (פ?). After a corroded stretch (A x~290-380, room for ~1-2 letters, only indistinct traces) the last word shows 2 clear letters: a vertical with a head (ו/י, A x~258-272) and then a box-shaped letter with top, right side, base and an apparently closed, angled left side (ם, alternatives ב/כ/ס; A x~200-245). Transcription of the visible part: ?ום or ?וכ. Two letters are visible for certain. Whether the word had four letters (two more in the corroded stretch) cannot be decided.
P28.evidence: A x~180-460 at 3.2-4.5x (plain, CLAHE): ink profile shows letters at x~195-240 and 260-275, then only weak traces at 300-370, then my pos 18 at 380-445. B left strip shows the same pair (box at B x~335-370, vertical at B x~382-388; a long crack at B x~380). Right of the pair in B is the strip boundary (B x~420-460), so B cannot show the corroded stretch.

P29.answer: The first word is only partly preserved. The metal is broken away at target height right of A x~1140, and the surviving letters stand on the upper edge of the break, ~30 px higher than the rest of the line. From the right: two verticals (A x~1100-1110 and x~1130-1140, on the break edge), a V-shaped letter (A x~1040-1075; ע/ש), a letter with top bar, right side closing into a bowl and a long separate left leg descending below it (ק, possible; A x~943-1000), then a letter with head, top bar and right vertical plus a short leftward stroke low on the left (ר, or possibly ת with a foot; A x~860-910). Between the ק and that last letter (A x~910-940) there is no stroke, so no ו is visible between ק and the following letter. The long vertical at A x~945 is attached to the ק's top bar and belongs to it. Number of letters: 3 certain positions (V-letter, ק, ר/ת) plus 1-2 verticals on the break edge, i.e. 4-5 visible, with the right-hand beginning lost.
P29.evidence: A 3-6x zooms x~840-1250 y~10-140. C left strip shows the break and a closed box with a long left side (C x~570-705), compatible with the ק. B right strip shows letters on the break edge but they are not resolvable.

P29.answer: After the two box letters with bases (Stage-1 pos 7-8, which I read as בב with alternative כ; they can be ככ), the signs are, right to left: (1) one large hook-shaped sign: a long top bar (A x~505-570, y~95-100) with a heavy stroke descending diagonally from its right end to the lower left (to ~x535, y~140), like a 'ר' with a diagonal leg. In Stage 1 I read it as ר (possible). (2) A group of vertical strokes: 3 clear parallel verticals of similar height with small heads (A x~432-440, 450-458, 470-480; y~85-150), and possibly a 4th fainter one at A x~410-425. Total: 1 hook/diagonal sign + 3 (possibly 4) unit strokes. A word space (A x~580-635) separates the second box letter from the hook sign. Left of the verticals is a horizontal + vertical trace (A x~345-395) in a corroded area that I cannot identify.
P29.evidence: A 3.4-5x zooms x~330-640 (plain and CLAHE); ink profile peaks at x~432, 452, 472 (plus a weak one at ~415). B right strip: 3 verticals at B x~935-985 followed by the large diagonal sign at B x~1010-1050 (same order). B left strip: 4-5 vertical grooves at B x~340-445 crossed by a crack, less clear. C does not preserve this part.

P30.answer: Tentative. Taking my Stage-1 pos 14-15 (ש + a worn small letter) as של and pos 16-18 (ב, a vertical with a head, a roofed letter whose left leg has a small foot) as בית, the next word runs through a worn stretch: pos 19 (?), pos 20 (V-shaped, ע/ש), pos 21 (?), then a crack, then ל (pos 22), ב (pos 23), and then a small closed box (pos 24, A x~380-420). This is the first letter in that stretch that could be a final form. It is a closed shape: top stroke y~92, left side, a diagonal right side and a clear bottom stroke y~115-120, i.e. a closed box (ם type) sitting in the upper two-thirds of the line. However, a thin straight vertical at its left edge (A x~380-385) runs down to y~160, ~30 px below the baseline, like a ן stroke. It is parallel to and just right of a vertical fold (A x~345-365), so it may be a crack. My reading: closed box, favouring ם, with the descender more likely damage. I cannot confirm where the word ends.
P30.evidence: A 4.5-7x zooms x~340-520 y~50-170; ink profile below the baseline shows some ink at x~380-400 (the thin vertical) and at x~345-350 (pos 25 vertical, left of the fold). C middle strip shows a ב and two roofed letters in the בית area but does not clearly cover the box letter.
